$comment: Every finding code, plan code (needs <code>_effect), stat code and view kind the backend profiler can emit, and its English template table — extracted from backend/lib/galaxy/ai/{data_perception,folder_profile}.py + webapps/galaxy/api/perception.py at origin/fix/ds-r3-profiler-20261112 @ f74176aac8 (static emit / blocked_profile / _finding calls, the _EN_TEXT keys, _VIEW_STATS, VIEW_KINDS; extraction by AST). hdf5_groups (retired in round 3 for anndata_components) is no longer emitted; the client keeps its text only for stored older profiles. The sparse frontend checkout has no backend, so the list is committed; regenerate it when the profiler changes. Test: client/src/components/data-perception.codes.test.ts (enText must equal the en locale).

enText.alignment_no_read_groups: No read groups (@RG) in the header: GATK and most variant callers require them.
enText.alignment_not_coordinate_sorted: Sort order is {{order_words}}, not by coordinate: sort the file before indexing or variant calling.
enText.alignment_references: Reference sequences in the header: {{references}} ({{length}} bp in total).
enText.anndata_no_layers: No layers: the expression values are in X only.
enText.annotation_features: Feature lines: {{features}}; comment lines: {{comments}}; attribute keys ({{count}}): {{attributes}}.
enText.batch_confound: “{{column}}” (batch) lines up almost exactly with the groups, so batch and condition effects cannot be separated — a design problem for differential analysis.
enText.batch_covariate_effect: add “{{column}}” as a covariate before modelling
enText.blank_content: The file holds only blank lines.
enText.columns_comment: Column names taken from the file's last “#” comment line: {{columns}}.
enText.columns_generated: No header row detected (line 1 holds data values); columns are named column_1, column_2, …
enText.columns_spec: {{format}} files have no header row; column names follow the {{format}} specification: {{columns}}.
enText.comment_lines_skipped: Comment lines before the table were skipped: {{count}}.
enText.compressed_corrupt: The compressed data is corrupt partway through, so the file cannot be read reliably.
enText.compressed_truncated: The compressed file ends early (truncated): only the readable part was checked.
enText.compressed_unreadable: The compressed file could not be decompressed: it is corrupt or not actually compressed.
enText.dedup_splits_effect: de-duplicate rows across splits before evaluation
enText.duplicate_column_names: Column names used more than once: {{columns}}. Tools that look columns up by name keep only one of them or rename them.
enText.effective_n_dedup: Effective N ({{n}}) is below the row count ({{rows}}) — duplicate rows ({{duplicates}}) reduce the independent samples.
enText.effective_n_imbalance: Effective N ({{n}}) is far below the row count ({{rows}}) — bounded by the minority class under strong imbalance.
enText.fasta_high_n: {{pct}}% of bases are N (unknown): gaps or a low-quality assembly.
enText.fasta_orphan_lines: Sequence lines before the first “>” header, which were ignored: {{count}}.
enText.fasta_profiled_subset: Statistics cover the first {{mb}} MB of the file.
enText.fasta_sequences: Sequences: {{sequences}}; {{total}} {{unit}} in total; length mean {{mean}}, min {{min}}, max {{max}}, N50 {{n50}} (half of all bases lie in sequences at least this long).
enText.fastq_index_read: Index read ({{read}}) of sample {{sample}}: it holds the sample barcodes, not biological reads, and is used only for demultiplexing.
enText.fastq_low_quality: Mean base quality Phred {{q}} is below 20 (more than 1 error in 100 bases) — consider trimming.
enText.fastq_malformed_records: Records that do not follow the four-line FASTQ layout (or whose quality line differs in length from the sequence): {{count}} of {{checked}} checked.
enText.fastq_mate_missing: Read {{read}} of sample {{sample}}, but no read-{{missing}} mate is in this folder — it runs single-end unless the mate is added.
enText.fastq_mean_quality: Mean base quality: Phred {{q}} (sampled; Phred 20 = 1 error in 100 bases, 30 = 1 in 1,000).
enText.fastq_no_records: No FASTQ records could be parsed — the file may be malformed.
enText.fastq_orphan_single_end: Mate file missing from the folder
enText.fastq_orphan_single_end_effect: single-end for sample {{sample}} until the mate is added
enText.fastq_paired_end: Mate file in the same folder
enText.fastq_paired_mate: Paired-end: read {{read}} of sample {{sample}}; its mate {{mate}} is in the same folder.
enText.fastq_reads: Reads scanned: {{reads}}; mean read length {{mean_len}} bp.
enText.fastq_single_end_effect: single-end pipeline suggested (override if a paired mate exists)
enText.fastq_single_end_named: No read-1/read-2 naming and no mate in this folder: a single-end sample.
enText.fastq_single_file: A single FASTQ file was profiled — treated as single-end unless a mate file is present.
enText.few_data_rows: Too few data rows for the column and label checks (rows: {{rows}}).
enText.file_not_found: The file could not be found.
enText.format_header_unreadable: The {{format}} header could not be read; the file may be truncated or malformed.
enText.format_identified: Identified as {{format}} ({{size}}); its contents are not analysed here.
enText.format_metadata_only: {{format}} metadata was read; the data values themselves have not been analysed.
enText.format_metadata_skipped: {{format}} metadata was not read: the file ({{size}}) is above the {{cap}} limit for reading during upload.
enText.header_only: A header is present but there are no data rows.
enText.high_missing: Columns with at least {{pct}}% missing values: {{columns}}.
enText.intervals_unstranded: No strand column: the intervals are treated as unstranded.
enText.jsonl_skipped_lines: Lines that are not valid JSON were skipped: {{count}}.
enText.label_few_rows: Column “{{column}}” looks like a group column (e.g. condition), but with {{rows}} rows (at least {{min_rows}} needed) group sizes and columns that reveal the group were not checked.
enText.label_free_text: Column “{{column}}” looks like a label, but its distinct values ({{distinct}}) make it free text, not a class target.
enText.label_no_features: Column “{{column}}” looks like a group column, but the other columns are identifiers or annotation, so there is nothing to compare between the groups.
enText.label_spellings: Two spellings of the same label: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}”.
enText.leaked_feature: Column “{{column}}” matches the groups in {{pct}}% of rows — it may encode the group itself; check it before using it in a model.
enText.leaked_id: Column “{{column}}” differs in almost every row yet matches the groups exactly — it probably encodes the group (e.g. a sample ID containing the condition); do not use it as a predictor.
enText.minority_class: Class “{{label}}” is only {{pct}}% of rows — consider a balanced sampler.
enText.mtx_bad_header: Not a readable Matrix Market file: the %%MatrixMarket banner or the size line is missing.
enText.mtx_orientation: Matrix Market files carry no row or column names: pair this matrix with its features and barcodes files (10x: rows are features, columns are cells).
enText.mtx_tenx_set: 10x matrix: rows are the features in {{features}}, columns are the cells in {{barcodes}} (same folder).
enText.name_content_mismatch: Named as {{named}}, but the content is {{detected}} — it is shown and checked as {{detected}}.
enText.nested_blank_cells: {{pct}}% of the cells in the tables of column “{{column}}” are blank — typical of merged or multi-line cells in extracted tables; join continuation rows before analysis.
enText.nested_row_cap: {{pct}}% of the tables in column “{{column}}” have the maximum row count ({{max_rows}}), far more than any other size: they were probably cut off when extracted. Check the extraction before analysing them.
enText.nested_tables: Column “{{column}}” holds embedded tables: {{tables}}; rows per table: median {{median_rows}}, largest {{max_rows}}; columns per table: median {{median_cols}}.
enText.no_columns: No columns could be parsed from the table.
enText.nul_bytes: Lines with NUL bytes, which were ignored: {{lines}}.
enText.parse_failed: The file could not be parsed; it may be malformed or in a different format than its name suggests.
enText.profiled_subset: Statistics were computed on the first {{profiled}} of {{rows}} rows.
enText.ragged_rows: Rows whose number of fields differs from the header's ({{expected}}): {{count}}.
enText.split_overlap: Feature rows that appear in more than one split: {{count}} — train/test overlap.
enText.spreadsheet_convert: Spreadsheets are not checked cell by cell: export the sheet to CSV to get the table checks.
enText.spreadsheet_preview: Preview of sheet “{{sheet}}”: its first rows (rows shown: {{rows}}).
enText.structure_experimental: Experimental structure ({{method}}): the B-factor column holds atomic displacement, not prediction confidence.
enText.structure_predicted: Predicted model ({{predictor}}), not an experimental structure: the B-factor column holds the predictor's per-residue confidence (pLDDT for AlphaFold-type models).
enText.structured_only: Valid {{format}} syntax ({{root}} root). Only the structure was checked; scientific quality has not been assessed.
enText.structured_too_large: Structural validation is limited to files under 2 million characters; download the file for a complete check.
enText.table_clean: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; groups are balanced, no column gives the group away, and no column is constant.
enText.table_clean_label_unchecked: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; no constant columns or missing-value problems.
enText.table_clean_unlabelled: Rows: {{rows}} · columns: {{cols}}; no constant columns or missing-value problems. No group column (e.g. condition) was found, so group sizes were not checked.
enText.tenx_member_headerless: Part of the 10x matrix {{matrix}} in this folder: header-less by the 10x specification, so line 1 is data.
enText.text_encoding_legacy: The file is not UTF-8 text; it was read as {{encoding}}. Check that accented or non-Latin characters display correctly — tools that expect UTF-8 may misread them.
enText.text_encoding_replaced: Byte sequences that are not valid UTF-8 were replaced with “�”: {{count}}.
enText.unprofilable: This file type cannot be profiled ({{name}}); only its shape is reported, no leakage or balance checks.
enText.unresolvable_ref: The dataset reference could not be resolved to a readable file.
enText.vcf_malformed_lines: Data lines with fewer than 8 tab-separated columns: {{count}}.
enText.vcf_no_variants: No variant records were found (header only).
enText.vcf_sized_effect: variant annotation and filtering plan sized accordingly
